name: Biggest Fan
description: An Angels of Delusion superfan for life!

skills.name: I Stan My Angels
skills.description:
Active Skill
Upon activating this skill, Biggest Fan starts cheering, continuously restoring HP to the currently controlled character based on Biggest Fan's Max HP.

skills.name: Fandom Power Unleashed
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Angels of Delusion characters in your squad: When Biggest Fan uses its Active Skill, all Agents in the squad gain 50 ATK for 30s.
The Attribute Anomaly Buildup dealt by Bangboo Chain Attack is increased by 15%.

skills.name: Grab the Merch!
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Swings glow sticks to attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG and massive Ether Anomaly Buildup.

name: Sprout
description: Don't underestimate our bond!

skills.name: Six-Star Flight
skills.description:
Active Skill
When the skill activates, if there's no Sword on the field, Sprout summons six flying swords to attack the target, dealing Physical DMG and accumulating Physical Anomaly Buildup.
If a Sword is already on the field, Sprout steps onto it and charges up, unleashing a stronger flurry of slashes that deals massive Physical DMG and accumulates Physical Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Heartbound Bond
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When Ye Shunguang is in the squad: Sprout's DMG increases by 30%. When using its Active Skill while in Ether Veil: Verdict, 1 Sword is summoned to the field.

skills.name: Sword of Unification
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Summons a massive Sword of Unification that stabs enemies, dealing massive Physical DMG and accumulating Physical Anomaly Buildup.

name: Birkblick
description: We're both caught in the camera's eye.

skills.name: Montage Combo
skills.description:
Active Skill
Deploys a floating turret that can fire up to 3 laser volleys at the target, dealing Physical DMG and accumulating a large amount of Daze.

skills.name: Observer Effect
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Krampus Compliance Authority characters in your squad: When an Agent uses an EX Special Attack, Birkblick's Daze inflicted increases by 4%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. At 3 stacks, DMG increases by 10%.

skills.name: Battlefield Close-Up
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Fires a powerful laser from the floating turret, dealing massive Physical DMG.

name: Bild N. Boolok
description: Don't step on the blocks barefoot.

skills.name: Block Hopscotch
skills.description:
Active Skill
Swings a staff and assembles blocks into a giant hammer to attack the enemy. After hitting the enemy four times or completing three hammer swings, leaps up and slams down, causing Block Spikes to erupt outward. Enemies take Physical DMG upon coming into contact with Block Spikes.

skills.name: Red Light! Nobody Move!
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 1 Support character in your squad: Bild N. Boolok's Active Skill releases 7 Block Spikes, and its Active Skill DMG increases by 30%.

skills.name: Castle Dodgeball
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Swings its staff with full force, launching blocks ahead to deal massive Physical DMG.

name: Miss Esme
description: In the name of Starshine, I shall alter the course of destiny!

skills.name: Starbeam Transformation
skills.description:
Active Skill
Transform and take flight, randomly summoning three Spectral Bubbles or Twinkling Stars in quick succession:
When a character touches a Spectral Bubble they restore HP.
When a character touches a Twinkling Star they regain Energy.
The greater the on-field character's HP percentage, the higher the chance Miss Esme has of summoning a Twinkling Star.

skills.name: Starshine Shift
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Spook Shack character(s) in your squad:
When a character touches a Spectral Bubble, HP recovered increases by 20%.
When a character touches a Twinkling Star, Energy generated increases by 20%.

skills.name: Stellar Bomb
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Hurl a magical bomb, dealing Physical DMG and accumulating massive Physical Anomaly Buildup.

name: Mercury
description: A Bangboo uninterested in military merits is not a good soldier.

skills.name: Tactical Strategy I: Frontline Suppression
skills.description:
Active Skill
Mercury summons a vehicle and drives it, unleashing continuous flames at enemies to deal massive Fire DMG.

skills.name: Tactical Strategy II: Combat Synergy
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Defense Force characters in your squad: When an Agent deals Aftershock DMG, Mercury's next Active Skill gains 22.5% increased DMG. Can stack once every 5s, up to 2 stacks.

skills.name: Tactical Strategy III: Explosive Ambush
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Loads itself into the vehicle as ammunition and fires at enemies, detonating on impact and dealing massive Fire DMG.

name: Belion
description: The true essence of martial arts is the lightness and purity of heart.

skills.name: Phoenix Ball Dance
skills.description:
Active Skill
Hurl a stone ball at the enemy, that bounces between them, dealing massive Physical DMG to all enemies hit.

skills.name: Way of Clouds
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there are 2 or more Yunkui Summit characters in your squad: Belion's DMG increases by 25%. When an Agent activates an Ultimate, the cooldown of Belion's Active Skill is reduced by 4s. Can trigger up to 2 times. Belion's Active Skill refreshes the available trigger count.

skills.name: Silver Lion Crash
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Performs a spinning, ramming attack on enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.

name: Booressure
description: Understanding the mood of a conversation is key to becoming a Bangboo social expert.

skills.name: Ether Bubble
skills.description:
Active Skill
Releases Ether bubbles that generate Energy for characters coming into contact with them.

skills.name: Balanced Pressure
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least one Support character in your squad: When Ether bubbles come into contact with characters, they additionally generate 60% of the original effect's Energy for off-field characters.

name: Devilboo
description: The only thing more tempting than a devil... is Devilboo!

skills.name: Kiss of Temptation
skills.description:
Active Skill
Enters the flying state, shooting homing bullets at enemies to deal Ether DMG and inflict Ether Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Ether Activity Increase
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Ether Attribute characters in your squad:
Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 40% more Anomaly Buildup.
After activating Bangboo Chain Attack, the coordination state lasts for 5 more seconds and can activate 4 more times.

skills.name: Kiss of Confusion
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Fires a laser at the target and then enters the coordination state. Under this state, fires homing bullets in coordination with the on-field character's attacks, dealing Ether DMG and inflicting Ether Anomaly Buildup for up to 30s or 10 activations.

name: Resonaboo
description: Accumulating Ether energy...

skills.name: Mini-Black Hole
skills.description:
Active Skill
Summons an Ether black hole that continuously pulls in enemies, dealing Ether DMG to enemies struck and accumulating Ether Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Radiation Effect
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Ether Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Primordial Black Hole
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Throws an Ether bomb at the target, dealing Ether DMG and accumulating massive Ether Anomaly Buildup.

name: Officer Cui
description: Though it may be a Bangboo, it's even more intimidating than a Security Canine!

skills.name: Awoo! Woof Woof!
skills.description:
Active Skill
Launches a two hit attack, tearing and biting enemies ahead and dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Provisional Security Canine
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Criminal Investigation Special Response Team characters in your squad: After using an Active Skill, there is a 50% chance to follow-up with 1 extra hit of the biting attack, up to a maximum of 3 consecutive triggers.
Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by 35%.

skills.name: Woof Woof Woof Woof!
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Continuously bites and tears enemies in front, dealing massive Physical DMG.

name: Snap
description: Its flash only shines for true superstars.

skills.name: Snap! Look at the Camera!
skills.description:
Active Skill
Wipes the lens, obtaining 3 Film. While Snap has Film, when an Agent triggers a Dodge Counter, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, Snap will consume 1 Film to take a snapshot and apply the Superstar status to the Agent, increasing their DMG for 10s.

skills.name: Superstar Moment
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Stars of Lyra characters in the squad: When Snap applies the Superstar status to an Agent, immediately restore the Agent's Health equal to 4% of its Max HP.

skills.name: Snap! Don't Blink!
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Use a powerful flash against the target, dealing Ether DMG and accumulating Ether Anomaly Buildup.

name: Agent Gulliver
description: Security check! Open up!

skills.name: Emergency Operation
skills.description:
Active Skill
Shoots 3 piercing attacks, dealing Electric DMG and accumulating Electric Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Bangboo Assault Squad
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Hollow Special Operations Section 6 characters in your squad: When Active Skill or Bangboo Chain Attack hit Shocked enemies, the DMG increases by 30%. When attacking enemies under other non-Electric Attribute Anomalies, attacks accumulate 60% more Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Assault Time
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Shoots 1 powerful piercing attack, dealing Electric DMG and inflicting massive Electric Anomaly Buildup.

name: Overtimeboo
description: Fatigue levels rising... Beep — now over 100!

skills.name: Corporate Drone Max!
skills.description:
Active Skill
Rams the target enemy with a computer and desk, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Keyboard Smasher
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 1 Attack or Anomaly character in your squad: Every activation of the Active Skill boosts Active Skill DMG by 25%, up to a maximum of 100%.

name: Bangvolver
description: Today's Fortune: Amazing!

skills.name: Revolver of Fortune
skills.description:
Active Skill
Use a random bullet for different moves:
Powerful Firework Shell: Fires at the enemy with great force, dealing massive Physical DMG and accumulating a large amount of Physical Anomaly Buildup.
Regular Firework Shell: Fires at the enemy, dealing Physical DMG and accumulating Physical Anomaly Buildup.
Paintball: Fails to fire as flowers leave the muzzle.

skills.name: Luck is Skill
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Physical Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Lucky Trigger
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Fire continuous shots at the target, dealing Physical DMG and accumulating massive Physical Anomaly Buildup.

name: Butler
description: A perfect butler for a perfect you.

skills.name: Tea Break
skills.description:
Active Skill
Creates a heartfelt afternoon snack. The snack will generate Energy for the receiving Agent once made and delivered.

skills.name: Personal Butler
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Victoria Housekeeping Co. characters in your squad: Active Skill generates an additional 20% Energy.

skills.name: Afternoon Dessert
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Use a frying pan and pancakes to attack enemies from afar, dealing massive Physical DMG.

name: Rocketboo
description: This Bangboo accelerates for 17.5 steps when running a hundred kilometers.

skills.name: Boom!
skills.description:
Active Skill
Mounts a rocket and charges at the target. Upon hitting a target, the rocket will explode, dealing Fire DMG to enemies within range and accumulating Fire Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Refueling
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Fire Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Ka-Boom Express Shipping
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Mounts a rocket and charges at the target. Upon hitting a target, the rocket will explode, dealing Fire DMG to enemies in a large area and inflicting massive Fire Anomaly Buildup.

name: Sharkboo
description: Seen in the distant seas and the seafood section of the fresh food market.

skills.name: Drylands Shark Hunt
skills.description:
Active Skill
Plants a homing trap underfoot which bites, tears, and summons torpedos at triggering enemies, dealing Ice DMG and accumulating Ice Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Cold Surge
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Ice Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Relentless Pursuit
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Summons a homing trap and leaps toward the target, causing an explosion upon landing that deals Ice DMG and accumulates massive Ice Anomaly Buildup.

name: Plugboo
description: "Beeeeep... beep... beep beep."

skills.name: Shock Sniper
skills.description:
Active Skill
Unleashes an EM cannon attack on the enemy, dealing Electric DMG and accumulating Electric Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Electromancer
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Electric Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 100% more Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: High-Voltage Resistance
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Unleash a strong electric attack on all nearby enemies in a large area, dealing Electric DMG and inflicting massive Electric Anomaly Buildup.

name: Brawlerboo
description: Ten thousand en-nah forward punches as practice per day!

skills.name: Falling Bangboo Asteroid Strike!
skills.description:
Active Skill
Charges up and rises into the air, entering the Airborne state. While in the Airborne state, Brawlerboo will dive attack enemies when they're hit by a heavy attack from an Agent, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: Opening Jab
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Anomaly character: Brawlerboo enters the Airborne state ahead of time when the battle starts. The first dive attack's DMG is increased by 120%.

skills.name: Scorching Wind Strike
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Jump up and strike continuously at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing Fire DMG.

name: Red Moccus
description: I'll be waiting for you on the off-road section of the Outer Ring!

skills.name: Roaring Wheels
skills.description:
Active Skill
Rides a motorcycle and pushes the farthest enemy towards the Agent, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Drifting Technique
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Sons of Calydon characters in your squad: Active Skill DMG increases by 36%. After an Active Skill deals DMG to an enemy, when that enemy is defeated, the skill's cooldown is reduced by 4s.

skills.name: Mad Charge
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Run enemies over with a motorcycle and detonate an explosion, dealing massive Physical DMG.

name: Baddieboo
description: Don't mess with it... It won't care if you're a human or Bangboo when it gets angry!

skills.name: Rocket Barrage
skills.description:
Active Skill
Sends rockets and molotov cocktails at the target enemy, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: Unusually Short Fuse
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least one Anomaly character in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by 20%. When the target is an Organic enemy, this buff increases by an additional 15%.

skills.name: Rocket Blast!
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Jumps forward and fires a rocket, dealing Fire DMG to enemies in a large area ahead.

name: Safety
description: Safety first, ehn-na second.

skills.name: Boring Burst
skills.description:
Active Skill
Enters the driving state and charges enemies, launching a drilling attack upon hit and dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Drill Team Mobilization
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Belobog Heavy Industries characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by 20%. If the target is Burning or Shocked, this buff increases by an additional 20%.

skills.name: Demolition Drill
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Enters the driving state and charges enemies, launching a multi-hit drilling attack upon hit and dealing massive Physical DMG.

name: Knightboo
description: My steed and I can both bounce to accelerate!

skills.name: Knight, Charge Up!
skills.description:
Active Skill
Jump repeatedly while riding Pale Bouncy and summon 3 Knight's Stars. When characters come into contact with Knight's Stars, they recover Energy.

skills.name: Knight's Chivalry
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least one Support character in your squad: When characters come into contact with Knight's Stars, their ATK increases by 20 + Bangboo level × 1.2 for 10s.

skills.name: Knight, Bouncing Charge!
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Summons 3 Pale Bouncys which stomp up to 10 times in the area ahead, each time dealing Ether DMG to enemies within its attack range.

name: Excaliboo
description: Only a sacred sword is needed to crown the true king.

skills.name: Sacred Sword Unleashed
skills.description:
Active Skill
Excaliboo attempts to draw the sword:
If the attempt fails, it performs a triple hammer strike, dealing Physical DMG.
If successful, it slashes the target with the sword, dealing massive Physical DMG.

skills.name: Victor's Oath
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 1 Rupture character in your squad: Upon using an Active Skill, the sword draw is guaranteed to succeed, and DMG increases by 30%.

skills.name: King's Unstoppable Might
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Strike forward with the sacred sword, dealing massive Physical DMG to enemies in front.

name: Robin
description: Three, two, one! Don't blink!

skills.name: The Curtain Falls
skills.description:
Active Skill
Fire a series of random cards using a magic gun, each triggering different effects based on card type:
Hearts – Deals massive Physical DMG.
Spades – Deals Physical DMG and inflicts massive Daze.
Crowns – Deals Ether DMG and accumulates massive Ether Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Master of Disguise
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 1 Mockingbird character in the squad: When the on-field Agent in the squad meets the Specialty requirements, the Active Skill fires a fixed card with a buff:
Attack: Fires only Hearts, increasing the DMG by 45%.
Stun: Fires only Spades, increasing the Daze buildup by 27%.
Anomaly: Fires only Crowns, increasing the Anomaly Buildup by 90%.

skills.name: Show Time!
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Throws a magic grenade forward, dealing Ether DMG and inflicting Ether Anomaly Buildup.

name: Amillion
description: A million Dennies in one Bangboo.

skills.name: Portable Machine Gun - Debt-Clearer
skills.description:
Active Skill
Builds a machine gun and continuously shoots enemies, dealing massive Physical DMG.

skills.name: Street Code
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Cunning Hares characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases with fewer enemies in combat, up to a max of 45%.

skills.name: Portable Machine Gun - Gatling Debt-Clearer
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Uses machine guns and cannons to continuously attack the target, dealing massive Physical DMG.

name: Sumoboo
description: A sumo wrestler never retreats!

skills.name: Finishing Move - Rock Crusher
skills.description:
Active Skill
Jumps towards the target and executes a downward strike, dealing Physical DMG in an area. This skill is good at interrupting.

skills.name: Overpower All Odds
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 1 Stun character in your squad: Active Skill inflicts 18% more Daze to enemies whose Daze is above 50%.

name: Luckyboo

skills.name: Lavish Spending

Active Skill
Strikes the target with a barrage of golden coins, dealing Physical DMG and accumulating Physical Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Luck is a Component of Power
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 2 Physical Attribute characters in your squad: Active Skill inflicts 20% more Anomaly Buildup.
Active Skill's continuous strikes duration is increased by 0.8s.

name: Electroboo
description: Bzzzt... Please wear insulated gloves when petting.

skills.description:

Charges the enemy and continuously electrocutes the target, dealing Electric DMG and accumulating Electric Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Inductive Current

When there's at least 2 Electric Attribute characters in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack inflicts 60% more Anomaly Buildup.

skills.name: Billion Volt Thunderbolt!
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Continually electrocutes the target, dealing Electric DMG and inflicting massive Electric Anomaly Buildup.

name: Exploreboo
description: Beep-beep-beep-beep. Does that mean there treasure or that it's running outta battery?

skills.name: Modded Ether Detector
skills.description:
Active Skill
Scans and excavates the nearby ground, then gives the character a random buff based on the Bangboo's stats:
Buff 1: Recovers HP.
Buff 2: Generates a Shield.
Buff 3: Increases Energy Regen.

skills.name: Ether Detection Specialist
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 1 Support character in your squad: Active Skill's character buff effect is increased:
Buff 1: HP Recovery increases by 20%.
Buff 2: Shield Generation increases by 20%.
Buff 3: Energy Regen increases by 0.04/s.

name: Avocaboo
description: A massive success among people who love veggie salads.

skills.name: Sweet and Juicy
skills.description:
Active Skill
Shoots juice bullets at the character currently on the battlefield. If the bullet misses, the juice will remain on the ground for a while. Characters coming into contact with the juice will recover HP. The recovery effect can only trigger up to 15 times per combat.

skills.name: Replenishing Sugar Levels
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 1 Support character in your squad:
Active Skill recovers 20% more HP.
Active Skill has 3 more charges.

name: Bagboo
description: There's a dark past hidden under that bag...

skills.name: Closer, Closer...

Unleashes a series of slashes with dual blades, dealing Physical DMG.

Bangboo Chain Attack
Continually slashes the target, dealing massive Physical DMG.

name: Boollseye
description: Right in the bull's eye!

skills.name: Straight in the Heart
skills.description:
Active Skill:
Throws a dart at the target, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Crossfire Missiles
skills.description:
Additional Ability
When there's at least 1 Pierce-type character in your squad: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by 30%.

skills.name: Dart of Desperation
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Launches itself with a slingshot, flying towards the target and performing consecutive slashes, dealing massive Physical DMG.

Uses a cardboard box to camouflage itself, inducing a taunt effect: While camouflaged, being attacked by enemies or reaching the camouflage time limit will trigger an explosion, dealing Physical DMG in an area.

skills.name: Paper Armor: Impact Mode
skills.description:
Bangboo Chain Attack
Enters a cardboard box and jumps at the target enemy, causing an explosion when it lands, dealing Physical DMG over a large area.
